from pathlib import Path
import os,json,hashlib,tarfile,time
p=Path('/home/zhangyuheng/projects/CHIP2026_PatientPheX/research/ncr-strong-biobert-control-backup/20261024-terminal-v1'); parts=[{'name': 'archive.part000', 'bytes': 262144, 'sha256': '9d4a31a32b75f6dce53938f4539451930a93ed35cf32ab0aec64ae0a050fa382'}, {'name': 'archive.part001', 'bytes': 262144, 'sha256': '36abe5d04df533cce63d6620eba458e3f8b56c1ec9e29cd230884401b958d936'}, {'name': 'archive.part002', 'bytes': 136515, 'sha256': '4c3da7e47a0d567ee57f125cb08a1c08389b44125ea96d75e60e225b36eecbdf'}]; expected={'archive_path': '/workspace/patientphex-runs/round2-20261023/research/public-neuralcr-readiness/strong-biobert-plus-ncr-preparation/persistent-terminal-backup/ncr-terminal-v1.tar.gz', 'archive_bytes': 660803, 'archive_sha256': 'bb9aa427b3fc28d81bc86e9103c818d5ecc7ee5fcd56b270d3a54dd7041adf02', 'members_manifest_sha256': 'c4e6ff9fde69983b60730d7e2f4f06ba488456e5a3ac24efa83d9d8c17c1ecc8', 'member_count': 65, 'uncompressed_source_bytes': 2462190, 'remote_target': 'research/ncr-strong-biobert-control-backup/20261024-terminal-v1/ncr-terminal-v1.tar.gz', 'mount_id': '5a9955da-5240-41cc-9e52-05d3d8da8a3c'}
assert os.getuid()==1006 and p.stat().st_uid==1006
for x in parts:
 b=(p/x['name']).read_bytes();assert len(b)==x['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==x['sha256']
target=p/'ncr-terminal-v1.tar.gz'
if not target.exists():
 temp=p/'archive.assembling'
 with temp.open('xb') as f:
  for x in parts:f.write((p/x['name']).read_bytes())
  f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
 assert temp.stat().st_size==expected['archive_bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(temp.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected['archive_sha256']
 os.replace(temp,target)
 d=os.open(str(p),os.O_RDONLY);os.fsync(d);os.close(d)
actual=hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest();assert actual==expected['archive_sha256'] and target.stat().st_size==expected['archive_bytes']
with tarfile.open(target,'r:gz') as t:
 members=t.getmembers();assert all(x.isfile() and not x.issym() and not x.islnk() and not x.name.startswith('/') and '..' not in Path(x.name).parts for x in members)
 assert len({x.name for x in members})==len(members)
 mb=t.extractfile('members.json').read();assert hashlib.sha256(mb).hexdigest()==expected['members_manifest_sha256'];manifest=json.loads(mb)
 assert len(members)==len(manifest['members'])+1 and set(x.name for x in members)==set(x['archive_path'] for x in manifest['members'])|{'members.json'}
 for x in manifest['members']:
  b=t.extractfile(x['archive_path']).read();assert len(b)==x['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==x['sha256']
result={'status':'PERSISTENT_ARCHIVE_FSYNC_FULL_SHA_AND_EVERY_MEMBER_VERIFIED','uid':os.getuid(),'at_epoch':time.time(),'locator':str(target),'bytes':target.stat().st_size,'sha256':actual,'member_count':len(manifest['members']),'all_member_size_SHA_exact':True,'no_gold_NN_weights_large_features_or_full_cache':True}
with (p/'stored-receipt.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(result,f,indent=2);f.write('\n');f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
print(json.dumps(result))
